title.en: Name the four tools of promotion
Explain features of advertising and objections to it

say.en: A great product nobody has heard of will not sell. Advertising, personal selling, sales promotion and public relations make sure people hear, believe and buy. In this lesson: Name the four tools of promotion.
Explain features of advertising and objections to it.
Identify sales promotion techniques.

body.en: Advertising is an impersonal form of communication paid for by an identified sponsor to promote goods or services. Its features are paid form, impersonality and identified sponsor. Objections: it adds to cost, undermines social values, confuses buyers, encourages sale of inferior products, and some ads are in bad taste. *Personal selling* is oral presentation in conversation with prospective buyers to make sales; it is personal, flexible and builds relationships.
body.kn: ಜಾಹೀರಾತು ಗುರುತಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಜಕರು ಹಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗತವಲ್ಲದ ಸಂವಹನ. ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಾರಾಟ ಸಂಭಾವ್ಯ ಖರೀದಿದಾರರೊಂದಿಗೆ ನೇರ ಮಾತುಕತೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಾರಾಟ.

body.en: *Sales promotion* means short-term incentives to encourage immediate purchase. Techniques: rebate, discount, refund, product combination, quantity gift, instant draws and assigned gift, lucky draw, usable benefit, full finance at 0%, sampling and contests. Public relations means managing communication to build a favourable image of the organisation with its publics, through press relations, product publicity, corporate communication, lobbying and counselling.

steps.en: (i) More quantity of the same product free: quantity gift.
(ii) Another product given free with the main one: product combination.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. Identify the sales promotion technique: (i) 'Buy a 1 kg pack, get 200 g extra free'; (ii) 'Buy a mixer, get a free steel jar'; (iii) free 10 g sachets of a new shampoo distributed door to door.

say.en: Let us work through this case together. Identify the sales promotion technique: i 'Buy a 1 kilogram pack, get 200 grams extra free'; ii 'Buy a mixer, get a free steel jar'; iii free 10 grams sachets of a new shampoo distributed door to door.
i More quantity of the same product free: quantity gift.
ii Another product given free with the main one: product combination.
iii Free trial packs: sampling.
So the answer is i Quantity gift, ii product combination, iii sampling.
